title: Bring the bots back
intro: The bots (LIT / ATLAS / BLITZ) never needed GitHub to trade. Only their reporting did. This puts the reporting on your main PC.

steps.title: Update the bot folder from the zip
steps.text: Double-click STOP_BOT.bat. Put the code zip and its .sha256.txt in Downloads on the PC, open the zip, copy UPDATE_FROM_ZIP.bat into the bot folder and double-click it (type Y if it asks).

steps.title: Double-click BOTS_BACK.bat
steps.text: in the bot folder. It checks NinjaTrader and its bars, starts the bots on Sim / paper (never a real account), turns the GitHub pushes off and ends with six lines. Note the phone alert topic it shows.

steps.title: iPhone:
steps.text: install the free ntfy app, tap +, type that topic, tap Subscribe. A test push arrives; after that every trade, a stale feed or a stopped bot pushes to your phone, and this site shows the PC's status every 15 minutes.

undo: Undo: UNDO_UPDATE.bat puts the old files back; UNDO_PUBLISH_NQ.bat removes the publish task.
limits: Netlify's new free plan allows about 20 deploys a month (each costs 15 of 300 credits; at zero the site pauses). So the publisher keeps a budget: at most 1 a day, 18 a month by default, and says so on its status line.
Check your real limit at app.netlify.com > Usage (the price page can change).
The phone live view (minute-by-minute) and phone remote control used GitHub; they are off. Phone alerts from the cloud monitor are gone; PC-side alerts still work.
Auto-update of the bot from GitHub is off: update with the zip and UPDATE_FROM_ZIP.bat (step 1).
